## Diagnóstico visual de los supuestos

<div class="text-justify mt-40" style="font-size: 30px;">

Los supuestos de regresión lineal pueden evaluarse visualmente mediante gráficos diagnósticos generados a partir de los residuos del modelo.

</div>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"

library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
set.seed(123)
n <- 100
x <- runif(n, 0, 10)
y <- 5 + 2 * x + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 2)
modelo <- lm(y ~ x)

df_diag <- data.frame(
  ajustados  = fitted(modelo),
  residuos   = residuals(modelo),
  std_res    = rstandard(modelo),
  sqrt_std   = sqrt(abs(rstandard(modelo)))
)

tema_diag <- theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16, color = "#1a3a6b"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold",
                                 color = "#ffffff",
                                 margin = margin(t = 4, b = 2)),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 0),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 14, color = "#374151"),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 12, color = "#374151"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(color = "#cbd5e1", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

etiqueta <- function(texto, color) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("label", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = texto,
             fill = color, color = "white", size = 5.2,
             fontface = "bold", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.45, "lines")) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
}

# 1. Residuos vs Ajustados
p1 <- ggplot(df_diag, aes(ajustados, residuos)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#b91c1c", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(color = "#1a3a6b", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d97706", linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Residuos vs. Ajustados",
       x = "Valores ajustados", y = "Residuos") +
  tema_diag

e1 <- etiqueta("Valida: Linealidad y Homocedasticidad", "#1a3a6b")

# 2. Q-Q Plot
p2 <- ggplot(df_diag, aes(sample = std_res)) +
  stat_qq(color = "#1a3a6b", size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "#b91c1c", linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plot de residuos",
       x = "Cuantiles teóricos", y = "Cuantiles muestrales") +
  tema_diag

e2 <- etiqueta("Valida: Normalidad de los residuos", "#1b4d2e")

# 3. Scale-Location
p3 <- ggplot(df_diag, aes(ajustados, sqrt_std)) +
  geom_point(color = "#1b4d2e", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d97706", linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Scale-Location",
       x = "Valores ajustados", y = expression(sqrt("|Residuos estand.|"))) +
  tema_diag

e3 <- etiqueta("Valida: Homocedasticidad", "#b45309")

col1 <- p1 / e1 + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.6))
col2 <- p2 / e2 + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.6))
col3 <- p3 / e3 + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.6))
col1 | col2 | col3
```
